name: Venice
introHeading: Documented ATER housing in mainland Venice.
intro: Explore 123 documented ATER public-housing locations in Chirignago, Favaro Veneto, Marghera and Mestre. Historic Venice and its islands are not covered by this source.
mapLabel: Interactive map of Venice public housing
footnote: 123 documented mainland locations, not a current census. This initial Venice release maps 568 ATER dwelling entries from the 2013 Veneto register, consolidated by civic location. The register contains no historic-centre or island entries; that absence does not indicate that public housing is not present there.

sources.label: Regione del Veneto — ATER Venezia dwellings excluded from sale (2013)

metadata.coverage: ATER Venezia locations listed as excluded from the Veneto regional 2013 sale plan; this is not a current or complete social-housing inventory.
